title: Dynamic Evidence Collection Ecosystem for Assessment Integrity and Authentic Competence
abstract: arXiv:2608.16016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) can produce high-quality essays, code, and design artefacts, challenging the validity of conventional assessments that rely on single-point submissions and product-only grading. This paper proposes a design framework called "Dynamic Evidence Collection Ecosystem" that shifts assessment toward continuous, authentic, multi-source evidence of student learning over time. The framework collects process evidence through iterative artefacts, design logs, activity rounds, self-reflection, and peer collaboration, supported by an AI-enabled layer for learning analytics, formative feedback, and transparency. The approach is grounded in recent assessment-redesign scholarship in AI-rich contexts and aligned with contemporary views of authenticity in assessment. translated_title: 动态证据收集生态系统：用于评估完整性与真实能力
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）能够生成高质量的论文、代码和设计作品，这挑战了依赖单次提交和仅基于成果评分的传统评估的有效性。本文提出了一种名为“动态证据收集生态系统”的设计框架，将评估转向对学生学习过程持续、真实、多源证据的考察。该框架通过迭代作品、设计日志、活动轮次、自我反思和同伴协作来收集过程证据，并由人工智能支持层提供学习分析、形成性反馈和透明度。该方法基于人工智能丰富背景下最新的评估重新设计学术研究，并与当代评估真实性观点相一致。本文基于以下假设：当学术完整性被视为评估设计问题而非人工智能检测问题时，其会得到加强。
tldr: 本文提出一种动态证据收集生态系统框架，通过持续多源过程证据和AI支持，将学术完整性视为评估设计而非检测手段，以应对GenAI对传统评估的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Dynamic Evidence Collection Ecosystem framework that uses continuous, multi-source process evidence and AI support to treat academic integrity as an assessment design issue rather than detection, addressing GenAI challenges to traditional assessment.
